title: Rational Functions
description: A rational function P/Q excludes every real input where the original denominator Q is zero.
outcomes: Identify rational functions and determine all excluded inputs from the original denominator before simplifying.
Identify removable discontinuities caused by common factors and distinguish formula equivalence from function equality.
Determine vertical asymptotes and describe one-sided behavior from factor signs and multiplicity.
Determine horizontal asymptotes from degree comparison and interpret them as long-run output behavior.
Use polynomial division to determine nonhorizontal asymptotes and describe the shrinking remainder term.
Find rational intercepts and determine positive and negative intervals using factored sign structure.
Construct a complete rational graph using domain, discontinuities, asymptotes, intercepts, signs, and selected values.
Solve rational equations and intersections exactly or numerically while rejecting excluded candidates.
Solve rational inequalities using critical values, sign intervals, and correct endpoint inclusion.
Build and interpret direct, inverse, joint, and combined variation models with meaningful parameters and domains.
Decompose proper rational functions with factorable denominators into simpler component fractions and verify recombination.
